violation_type.title: Written Activity Plan-  Screen Time Activities (26 TAC §746.2205(b))
violation_type.short_title: Written Activity Plan-  Screen Time Activities
violation_type.typical_finding: During inspection,  the schoolers classroom was observed with Netflix on that was not educational and did not correspond to the daily activities.

finding_variants.text: During inspection,  the schoolers classroom was observed with Netflix on that was not educational and did not correspond to the daily activities.
CCR observed screen time activities is not included in the activity plan.

Children were not offered an alternative activity to screen time when combined for morning drop off. There were no available toys, activities or centers for any of the children ranging from infants to pre k to engage in a different activity.
Screen time activities were not being included on written activity plans.
The four year olds were watching a movie that was not a planned activity and not curriculum based.    This was corrected when the teacher turned the video off while I was in the classroom.
